# Excel-saved .xlsb files whose flag, reserved and enum fields XlsbFlagCorpus treats as what Excel writes.
# One path per line, relative to tests/fixtures. Provenance is decided by where a file sits and how it was made,
# never by docProps/app.xml: our writer passes that part through, so our own outputs carry Excel's stamp too.
# Excluded: excel/open_gate_controls/ (deliberately damaged), excel/own_output/ (Formulon outputs), any *_resaved*
# file (a re-save of a workbook not authored in Excel), and every other Formulon output. xlsb_parity/**/<case>.xlsb and
# <case>.2.xlsb are Excel's two saves of one source. win/** files are Windows Excel saves.
